Apologies if you receive multiple copies of the email.

Just to let you know that the two posts for an Associate Professor (Maître de conférences) concerning my Research Team (SocSIM-K Social Simulation and Knowledge)
* have just been published:* See here

Look for the "LIG" lab.

More details on how to apply are here:

The deadline to apply via the Odyssée website is 2nd April 16h

If you work in the area of *Agent-based Social Simulation* and are interested in a permanent teaching (teaching in French)/research post at University Grenoble Alps, France, please contact me:
Julie.Dugdale@imag.fr <

>

Also, if you know of anyone who may be interested please feel free to forward this post.
